snapshot.name: atom_ant.z80
snapshot.note: Derived start state: Atom Ant (1990)(Hi-Tec)(48K-128K).tap (MD5 404e992b) loaded on a 128K machine and stopped at 9FF4, the game's own start once the AY music block is in bank 3 (games/atom_ant.md "Next session"). The .nxc builds the same state from the tape through TAP1.

recordings.name: atom_ant.tap
recordings.role: Atom Ant (1990)(Hi-Tec)(48K-128K).tap, the published patch's target, staged for provenance; not read by the build; not a recording.

recordings.name: atom_ant_loading.scr
recordings.role: The tape's 6,912-byte loading screen, staged beside the start state; not a recording.

recordings.name: atom_ant.256
recordings.role: Enhanced: the Spec256 set as a .256, staged beside the start state; game data, never in this repo; not a recording.

recordings.name: atom_ant_panel.bin
recordings.role: Enhanced: the set's panel at moments of play (256 x 32 values then 768 attributes each), dumped from the Spec256 set in the review run; derived from the set, never in this repo; not a recording.

recordings.name: atom_ant_palette.json
recordings.role: Enhanced: the set's 256 colours as RGB, from the review run; derived from the set, never in this repo; not a recording.

recordings.name: k1.rzx
recordings.role: Level 1 from the start state, scripted play, 4,041 frames. Also the broken builds' and ABI states' recording, to frame 500.

recordings.name: k2.rzx
recordings.role: Level 1 from the start state with deaths, 3,002 frames.

verify.note: The default runs no hook (no clash to remove), so it is proved by the boot check; the replay proves Enhanced: at every hook every register with R and all 48K RAM against the original; at every copy Layer 2 against a picture built independently from the map and plots, and the game's back buffer against the same model in mono; ABI cases (four clocks, both IFF values, eight R phases) and 11 broken builds on k1 to frame 500. Levels 3, 5, 7 and the level-end cycle were replayed from test copies in the review run (games/atom_ant.md "Evidence"), not here.

status.title: Atom Ant
status.build: v1.0; atom_ant_loading.nex 66d682f8 and atom_ant_enhanced_loading.nex c3d35756 equal the published .nxc 1.0 bare builds, default and Enhanced (without the screen 04460a95, 054ce8f7); default: the tape's 128K form with its AY music, no game byte changed, no hook, no clash to remove and none claimed; Enhanced, off by default: the Spec256 set's colours on a full double-buffered Layer 2 over the unchanged ULA; top banks 10 and 47, both fit a 1MB Next
status.next: hardware checklist; natural play to the end

results.scope: runs/atom_ant/release-20261108 and release-20261108b: pace, soak, flicker and the real loader, JNext 1.1.104; replays of levels 3, 5, 7 and the level-end cycle from test copies; on this engine's bytes. Not a selftest stamp.
